vignette: A young child presents with several open carious lesions in primary teeth. The parent asks how the dentist will manage the disease before the child can tolerate full conventional restorative care.
stem: Which statement best describes the role of interim therapeutic restorations (ITR) for this child?

options.text: They provide caries control for multiple open lesions as a temporary measure until definitive restoration.
They serve as the final restoration, so conventional cavity preparation and restoration will not be needed.
They should be avoided so that all treatment waits until the child needs sedation or general anesthesia.
They are unnecessary because definitive restorations alone will control the disease with no other measures.
